description: The Buddy list client's conversation windows (M15, docs/design/architecture.md): `chat-*`, each a conversation in a window of its own, popped out of the tabs beside the list or opened there because conversations open each in its own window (#337). The tabs themselves are in the list window. They draw their own title bars, so they may move, minimize, maximize and close themselves, and they open links in the person's browser, like the main window. They do not get notifications: only the list window (the owner) notifies. Events between windows are covered by core:default. Interface size zooms the page and grows the window to match (core/appearance.ts), which needs set-webview-zoom and set-size. Of the app's own commands (build.rs) they may call only seven: gateway_send, for typing through the list window's connection, graphics_started, the start-up check every window runs, sound_play, for the sound that answers a voice control pressed there (#241), played on the chosen speakers (#250, src/sounds.rs, which limits its length and loudness), and clipboard_image, for pasting an image into the message box on Linux, where WebKitGTK never shows the page one (#276, src/clipboard.rs). It reads only an image, never the clipboard's words, and no other window may call it (src/acl.rs). And clip_start, clip_stop and clip_cancel, for recording a voice message in the message box (#401, src/clip.rs): started and stopped by Record and Stop in the panel you opened, never a voice room, and nothing leaves the computer unless you press Send; the list window may call them too, for the conversations beside it, and no other window may (src/acl.rs). The keyring, the connections, voice and notifications stay the list window's.
